content:
# AND Operator

The AND operator `&&` checks whether two conditions are both true. Use `&&` when your app should only do something if both conditions are true.
name: AND Operator
tips:
- Use `&&` between two Boolean values or conditions.
- Both sides of `&&` must be true for the whole condition to be true.
- Put each comparison on its own side, like `score > 10 && isReady === true`.
- Do not use `&&` when only one condition needs to be true.
- In Web Lab, `&&` is often used to check multiple app states before updating the page.
